stem: Which Mughal ruler established Karkhanas for painting?

options.label: e

expl: Akbar was very fond of painting and during his reign, painting was organised as an imperial establishment or Karkhana called Tasvir Khana where the painters worked. stem: Musicians like Tansen, Baiju Bawra and Gopal Nayak had received training from the master Swami Haridas. How many music worship centres have been set up by the followers of Swami Haridas ?
expl: Swami Haridas was a spiritual poet and classical musician credited with a large body of devotional compositions, especially in the Dhrupad style. stem: With reference to Mian Tansen, which one of the following statements is not correct?

options.label: a
options.text: Tansen was the title given to him by Emperor Akbar.

options.label: b
options.text: Tansen composed Dhrupads on Hindu gods and goddesses.

options.label: c
options.text: Tansen composed songs on his patrons.

expl: The title of 'Tansen' was given by Raja Vikramjit Singh of Gwalior. Akbar gave the title of 'Mian'. Tansen also referred to as Ramtanu, was a prominent fi gure of Hindustani classical music. He was born in a Hindu family. He began his career and spent most of his adult life in the court and patronage of the Hindu King of Rewa, Raja Ramchandra Singh, where Tansen's musical abilities & studies gained widespread fame. Thus, his fame got the attention of the Mughal Emperor Akbar, who sent messengers to Raja Ramchandra Singh, requesting Tansen to join the musicians at Mughal court. He was a Vaishnava musician.
